source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including written/read and other notes; no normalized reconstruction.
source.public_versification_note: All 915 selected original verse records bind exactly once to matching public verse labels. No record partition or offset in this scope. Titles remain inside their verse labels.

delta_method: F0 retained wording; F1 lexical; F2 syntax/idiom; F3 consequential interpretive, textual, social, or versification choice. Editorial choices are independent of overlap scores. No minimum-change quota. Independent review has not occurred.

verses.before: The proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel:
verses.after: The proverbs of Solomon, son of David, king of Israel.
verses.tsw_comparator: The proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel:

verses.before: To know wisdom and discipline, to understand words of insight,
verses.after: For learning wisdom and discipline, for understanding words of insight;
verses.tsw_comparator: To know wisdom and discipline, to understand words of insight,

verses.before: to receive discipline in wise conduct, in righteousness, justice, and equity;
verses.after: for receiving discipline that teaches good judgment, righteousness, justice, and fairness;
verses.tsw_comparator: to receive discipline in wise conduct, in righteousness, justice, and equity;

verses.rationale: Retain specifically masculine learner and practical shrewdness.
verses.before: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young—
verses.after: for giving the inexperienced good sense, and a young man knowledge and discretion.
verses.tsw_comparator: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young—

verses.before: let the wise hear and increase in learning, and let the discerning acquire guidance,
verses.after: Let the wise listen and add to their learning; let the discerning gain guidance,
verses.tsw_comparator: let the wise hear and increase in learning, and let the discerning acquire guidance,

verses.before: to understand a proverb and a saying, the words of the wise and their riddles.
verses.after: to understand proverbs and figures of speech, the words of the wise and their riddles.
verses.tsw_comparator: to understand a proverb and a saying, the words of the wise and their riddles.

verses.rationale: Keep fear and beginning as foundational vocabulary.
verses.before: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge; fools despise wisdom and discipline.
verses.after: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge; fools despise wisdom and discipline.
verses.tsw_comparator: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge; fools despise wisdom and discipline.

verses.rationale: Both parents teach with distinct terms.
verses.before: Hear, my child, the discipline of your father, and do not abandon the instruction of your mother,
verses.after: My son, listen to your father’s discipline, and do not abandon your mother’s instruction.
verses.tsw_comparator: Hear, my child, the discipline of your father, and do not abandon the instruction of your mother,

verses.before: for they are a graceful wreath for your head and ornaments for your neck.
verses.after: They are a lovely garland for your head and ornaments for your neck.
verses.tsw_comparator: for they are a graceful wreath for your head and ornaments for your neck.

verses.before: My child, if sinners entice you, do not consent.
verses.after: My son, if sinners entice you, do not agree to go.
verses.tsw_comparator: My child, if sinners entice you, do not consent.

verses.rationale: Do not soften proposed gratuitous violence.
verses.before: If they say, “Come with us; let us lie in wait for blood; let us ambush the innocent without cause.
verses.after: They may say, “Come with us! Let’s lie in wait to spill blood; let’s ambush someone innocent for no reason.
verses.tsw_comparator: If they say, “Come with us; let us lie in wait for blood; let us ambush the innocent without cause.

verses.rationale: Keep death images and whole-person swallowing.
verses.before: Let us swallow them alive like Sheol, whole, like people who go down to the pit.
verses.after: Let’s swallow them alive, like Sheol, whole, like those going down to the Pit.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let us swallow them alive like Sheol, whole, like those who go down to the pit.

verses.rationale: Preserve the lure of stolen wealth.
verses.before: We will find all kinds of precious wealth; we will fill our houses with plunder.
verses.after: We will find all kinds of precious wealth and fill our houses with plunder.
verses.tsw_comparator: We will find all kinds of precious wealth; we will fill our houses with plunder.

verses.rationale: Retain lot and common purse images.
verses.before: Cast your lot among us; we will all have one purse”—
verses.after: Throw in your lot with us; we will all share one purse.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Cast your lot among us; we will all have one purse”—

verses.before: my child, do not walk in the way with them; keep your foot from their path,
verses.after: My son, do not walk their road; keep your feet off their path.
verses.tsw_comparator: my child, do not walk in the way with them; keep your foot from their path,

verses.before: for their feet run toward evil, and they hurry to shed blood.
verses.after: Their feet run toward evil; they hurry to spill blood.
verses.tsw_comparator: for their feet run toward evil, and they hurry to shed blood.

verses.before: For a net is spread in vain before the eyes of any bird,
verses.after: A net is spread in vain in full view of any bird.
verses.tsw_comparator: For a net is spread in vain before the eyes of any bird,

verses.before: but these lie in wait for their own blood; they ambush their own lives.
verses.after: But these men lie in wait for their own blood; they ambush their own lives.
verses.tsw_comparator: but these lie in wait for their own blood; they ambush their own lives.

verses.before: Such are the paths of everyone greedy for unjust gain; it takes away the life of the one who possesses it.
verses.after: Such are the paths of everyone greedy for gain: it takes the life of those who possess it.
verses.tsw_comparator: Such are the paths of everyone greedy for unjust gain; it takes away the life of the one who possesses it.

verses.before: Wisdom cries aloud in the street; in the public squares she raises her voice.
verses.after: Wisdom cries out in the street; she raises her voice in the public squares.
verses.tsw_comparator: Wisdom cries aloud in the street; in the public squares she raises her voice.

verses.before: At the head of the noisy streets she calls; at the entrances of the city gates she speaks her words:
verses.after: At the head of the noisy streets she calls; at the city gates she speaks her words:
verses.tsw_comparator: At the head of the noisy streets she calls; at the entrances of the city gates she speaks her words:

verses.rationale: Retain three audiences and deliberate repetition.
verses.before: “How long, O simple ones, will you love being simple? How long will scoffers delight in scoffing, and fools hate knowledge?
verses.after: “How long, you inexperienced ones, will you love inexperience? How long will scoffers delight in scoffing and fools hate knowledge?
verses.tsw_comparator: “How long, O simple ones, will you love being simple? How long will scoffers delight in scoffing, and fools hate knowledge?

verses.rationale: Preserve spirit image rather than reducing to information.
verses.before: Turn at my correction. Look, I will pour out my spirit to you; I will make my words known to you.
verses.after: Turn when I rebuke you! Then I will pour out my spirit to you and make my words known to you.
verses.tsw_comparator: Turn at my correction. Look, I will pour out my spirit to you; I will make my words known to you.

verses.before: Because I called and you refused, I stretched out my hand and no one paid attention;
verses.after: I called, but you refused; I stretched out my hand, but no one paid attention.
verses.tsw_comparator: Because I called and you refused, I stretched out my hand and no one paid attention;

verses.before: because you ignored all my counsel and would have none of my correction,
verses.after: You dismissed all my counsel and would have none of my rebuke.
verses.tsw_comparator: because you ignored all my counsel and would have none of my correction,

verses.before: I also will laugh at your disaster; I will mock when your dread comes,
verses.after: So I too will laugh at your disaster; I will mock when terror comes upon you,
verses.tsw_comparator: I also will laugh at your disaster; I will mock when your dread comes,

verses.rationale: Follow read form and retain accumulating disaster clauses.
verses.before: when your dread comes like a storm and your disaster comes like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come upon you.
verses.after: when terror sweeps over you like devastation and disaster arrives like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come upon you.
verses.tsw_comparator: when your dread comes like a storm and your disaster comes like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come upon you.

verses.rationale: Retain shift from you to they.
verses.before: Then they will call to me, but I will not answer; they will seek me diligently, but they will not find me,
verses.after: Then they will call me, but I will not answer; they will search for me, but will not find me.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then they will call to me, but I will not answer; they will seek me diligently, but they will not find me,

verses.before: because they hated knowledge and did not choose the fear of the LORD.
verses.after: Because they hated knowledge and did not choose the fear of the LORD,
verses.tsw_comparator: because they hated knowledge and did not choose the fear of the LORD.

verses.before: They would have none of my counsel; they despised all my correction.
verses.after: because they wanted none of my counsel and rejected every rebuke I gave,
verses.tsw_comparator: They would have none of my counsel; they despised all my correction.

verses.rationale: Preserve eating metaphor and self-chosen consequences.
verses.before: So they will eat the fruit of their way and be filled with their own schemes.
verses.after: they will eat the fruit of their own way and have their fill of their own schemes.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore they will eat the fruit of their way and be filled with their own schemes.

verses.before: For the turning away of the simple will kill them, and the complacency of fools will destroy them.
verses.after: The turning away of the inexperienced kills them; the complacency of fools destroys them.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the turning away of the simple will kill them, and the complacency of fools will destroy them.

verses.rationale: Close Wisdom’s speech with security promise.
verses.before: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely and will be at ease, without dread of harm.”
verses.after: But whoever listens to me will live securely, at ease, without fear of disaster.”
verses.tsw_comparator: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely and will be at ease, without dread of harm.”

verses.before: My child, if you receive my words and treasure my commandments within you,
verses.after: My son, if you receive my words and store up my commands within you,
verses.tsw_comparator: My child, if you receive my words and treasure my commandments within you,

verses.before: making your ear attentive to wisdom and inclining your heart to understanding;
verses.after: making your ear attentive to wisdom and turning your heart toward understanding,
verses.tsw_comparator: making your ear attentive to wisdom and inclining your heart to understanding;

verses.before: if indeed you call out for insight and raise your voice for understanding;
verses.after: if you call out for insight and raise your voice for understanding,
verses.tsw_comparator: if indeed you call out for insight and raise your voice for understanding;

verses.before: if you seek it like silver and search for it like hidden treasures,
verses.after: if you seek it like silver and search for it like buried treasure,
verses.tsw_comparator: if you seek it like silver and search for it like hidden treasures,

verses.before: then you will understand the fear of the LORD and find the knowledge of God.
verses.after: then you will understand the fear of the LORD and find the knowledge of God.
verses.tsw_comparator: then you will understand the fear of the LORD and find the knowledge of God.

verses.before: For the LORD gives wisdom; from the LORD’s mouth come knowledge and understanding.
verses.after: For the LORD gives wisdom; knowledge and understanding come from his mouth.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the LORD gives wisdom; from the LORD’s mouth come knowledge and understanding.

verses.rationale: Follow read form; retain shield and integrity.
verses.before: The LORD stores up sound wisdom for the upright, a shield to people who walk in integrity,
verses.after: He stores up sound wisdom for the upright; he is a shield for those who walk with integrity,
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD stores up sound wisdom for the upright, a shield to those who walk in integrity,

verses.rationale: Follow plural read form for faithful ones.
verses.before: guarding the paths of justice and keeping the way of the LORD’s faithful ones.
verses.after: guarding the paths of justice and protecting the way of his faithful ones.
verses.tsw_comparator: guarding the paths of justice and keeping the way of the LORD’s faithful ones.

verses.before: Then you will understand righteousness and justice and equity— every good path.
verses.after: Then you will understand righteousness, justice, and fairness— every good path.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then you will understand righteousness and justice and equity— every good path.

verses.before: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
verses.after: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
verses.tsw_comparator: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

verses.before: Discretion will watch over you; understanding will guard you,
verses.after: Discretion will watch over you; understanding will guard you,
verses.tsw_comparator: Discretion will watch over you; understanding will guard you,

verses.rationale: Retain male agent and speech distortion.
verses.before: rescuing you from the way of evil, from people who speak perverse things,
verses.after: rescuing you from the way of evil, from the man whose speech is twisted,
verses.tsw_comparator: rescuing you from the way of evil, from those who speak perverse things,

verses.before: who abandon upright paths to walk in ways of darkness,
verses.after: from those who leave straight paths to walk along dark ways,
verses.tsw_comparator: who abandon upright paths to walk in ways of darkness,

verses.before: who rejoice in doing evil and delight in the perversity of evil,
verses.after: who rejoice in doing evil and delight in evil’s perversity,
verses.tsw_comparator: who rejoice in doing evil and delight in the perversity of evil,

verses.before: whose paths are crooked and whose ways are twisted.
verses.after: whose paths are crooked and whose courses are devious.
verses.tsw_comparator: whose paths are crooked and whose ways are twisted.

verses.rationale: Contextual sexual outsider; do not assert foreign ethnicity.
verses.before: Wisdom will rescue you from the strange woman, from the foreign woman who makes her words smooth,
verses.after: Wisdom will also rescue you from the forbidden woman, from the outsider whose words are smooth,
verses.tsw_comparator: Wisdom will rescue you from the strange woman, from the foreign woman who makes her words smooth,

verses.rationale: Keep companion and divine covenant without narrowing covenant’s referent.
verses.before: who abandons the companion of her youth and forgets the covenant of her God.
verses.after: who abandons the companion of her youth and forgets the covenant of her God.
verses.tsw_comparator: who abandons the companion of her youth and forgets the covenant of her God.

verses.before: For her house sinks down toward death, and her paths toward the dead.
verses.after: Her house sinks toward death, and her paths lead to the shades of the dead.
verses.tsw_comparator: For her house sinks down toward death, and her paths toward the dead.

verses.before: None who go to her return or reach again the paths of life.
verses.after: None who go to her return or reach the paths of life.
verses.tsw_comparator: None who go to her return or reach again the paths of life.

verses.before: So walk in the way of the good and keep to the paths of the righteous.
verses.after: So you will walk in the way of the good and keep to the paths of the righteous.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore walk in the way of the good and keep to the paths of the righteous.

verses.rationale: Keep land rather than spiritualizing place.
verses.before: For the upright will dwell in the land, and those of integrity will remain in it,
verses.after: For the upright will dwell in the land, and those of integrity will remain in it;
verses.tsw_comparator: For the upright will dwell in the land, and those of integrity will remain in it,

verses.before: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the treacherous will be torn from it.
verses.after: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the faithless will be uprooted from it.
verses.tsw_comparator: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the treacherous will be torn from it.

verses.rationale: Retain parental instruction rather than silently making divine speech.
verses.before: My child, do not forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments;
verses.after: My son, do not forget my instruction; let your heart keep my commands.
verses.tsw_comparator: My child, do not forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments;

verses.before: for length of days and years of life and abundant well-being they will add to you.
verses.after: They will add length of days, years of life, and peace to you.
verses.tsw_comparator: for length of days and years of life and abundant well-being they will add to you.

verses.rationale: Preserve paired virtues and inscription image.
verses.before: Do not let kindness and faithfulness forsake you; bind them around your neck; write them on the tablet of your heart.
verses.after: Let faithful love and faithfulness never leave you. Bind them around your neck; write them on the tablet of your heart.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not let kindness and faithfulness forsake you; bind them around your neck; write them on the tablet of your heart.

verses.rationale: Render good understanding contextually as reputation.
verses.before: So you will find favor and good repute in the sight of God and of humankind.
verses.after: Then you will find favor and a good reputation in the eyes of God and people.
verses.tsw_comparator: So you will find favor and good repute in the sight of God and of humankind.

verses.before: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and do not lean on your own understanding.
verses.after: Trust in the LORD with all your heart; do not lean on your own understanding.
verses.tsw_comparator: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and do not lean on your own understanding.

verses.rationale: Retain relational know rather than mere acknowledgment.
verses.before: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
verses.after: Know him in all your ways, and he will make your paths straight.
verses.tsw_comparator: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

verses.before: Do not be wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD, and turn from evil.
verses.after: Do not be wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD and turn away from evil.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not be wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD, and turn from evil.

verses.rationale: Body renders navel idiom; document concrete Hebrew in note.
verses.before: It will be healing to your flesh and refreshment to your bones.
verses.after: This will bring healing to your body and refreshment to your bones.
verses.tsw_comparator: It will be healing to your flesh and refreshment to your bones.

verses.rationale: Retain first produce rather than generic generosity.
verses.before: Honor the LORD with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your produce;
verses.after: Honor the LORD with your wealth and with the first of all your produce.
verses.tsw_comparator: Honor the LORD with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your produce;

verses.before: then your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will burst with new wine.
verses.after: Then your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
verses.tsw_comparator: then your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will burst with new wine.

verses.rationale: Keep correction as painful but not unspecified punishment.
verses.before: My child, do not despise the LORD’s discipline, and do not loathe his reproof,
verses.after: My son, do not reject the LORD’s discipline or resent his correction.
verses.tsw_comparator: My child, do not despise the LORD’s discipline, and do not loathe his reproof,

verses.before: for the LORD reproves the one he loves, as a father the child in whom he delights.
verses.after: For the LORD corrects the one he loves, like a father the son he delights in.
verses.tsw_comparator: for the LORD reproves the one he loves, as a father the child in whom he delights.

verses.before: Happy is the one who finds wisdom, and the one who gains understanding,
verses.after: Happy is the person who finds wisdom, the person who gains understanding.
verses.tsw_comparator: Happy is the one who finds wisdom, and the one who gains understanding,

verses.rationale: Feminine Wisdom and trade imagery remain.
verses.before: for her gain is better than the gain of silver, and her profit better than gold.
verses.after: Her profit is better than silver’s; her yield is better than gold.
verses.tsw_comparator: for her gain is better than the gain of silver, and her profit better than gold.

verses.rationale: Follow read form peninim; exact precious material uncertain.
verses.before: She is more precious than jewels, and nothing you desire can compare with her.
verses.after: She is more precious than jewels; nothing you desire can compare with her.
verses.tsw_comparator: She is more precious than jewels, and nothing you desire can compare with her.

verses.before: Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.
verses.after: Long life is in her right hand; in her left are wealth and honor.
verses.tsw_comparator: Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.

verses.rationale: Preserve repeated ways and comprehensive peace.
verses.before: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
verses.after: Her ways are pleasant ways, and all her paths are peace.
verses.tsw_comparator: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.

verses.rationale: Keep tree of life as biblical image.
verses.before: She is a tree of life to people who lay hold of her; people who hold her fast are called blessed.
verses.after: She is a tree of life to those who grasp her; those who hold her fast are happy.
verses.tsw_comparator: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her; those who hold her fast are called blessed.

verses.before: The LORD by wisdom founded the earth; by understanding he established the heavens.
verses.after: By wisdom the LORD founded the earth; by understanding he established the heavens.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD by wisdom founded the earth; by understanding he established the heavens.

verses.rationale: Preserve deeps and dew rather than general rain.
verses.before: By his knowledge the deeps broke open, and the clouds drop down dew.
verses.after: By his knowledge the deeps broke open, and the clouds drip dew.
verses.tsw_comparator: By his knowledge the deeps broke open, and the clouds drop down dew.

verses.rationale: Keep referential these with following specification.
verses.before: My child, do not let them slip from your sight; keep sound wisdom and discretion,
verses.after: My son, do not let these slip from your sight: guard sound wisdom and discretion.
verses.tsw_comparator: My child, do not let them slip from your sight; keep sound wisdom and discretion,

verses.before: and they will be life for your soul and adornment for your neck.
verses.after: They will be life for your soul and an adornment for your neck.
verses.tsw_comparator: and they will be life for your soul and adornment for your neck.

verses.before: Then you will walk on your way in safety, and your foot will not stumble.
verses.after: Then you will walk your road securely, and your foot will not stumble.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then you will walk on your way in safety, and your foot will not stumble.

verses.before: If you sit down, you will not be afraid; when you lie down, your sleep will be sweet.
verses.after: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
verses.tsw_comparator: If you sit down, you will not be afraid; when you lie down, your sleep will be sweet.

verses.rationale: Leave devastation’s relation to wicked open.
verses.before: Do not be afraid of sudden terror, or of the ruin that strikes the wicked when it comes,
verses.after: Do not fear sudden terror or the devastation of the wicked when it comes.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not be afraid of sudden terror, or of the ruin that strikes the wicked when it comes,

verses.rationale: Choose side for ambiguous confidence/side term; retain trap.
verses.before: for the LORD will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being caught.
verses.after: For the LORD will be at your side and keep your foot from being caught.
verses.tsw_comparator: for the LORD will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being caught.

verses.rationale: Follow singular hand read form through power idiom.
verses.before: Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in your power to do it.
verses.after: Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due when it is in your power to act.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in your power to do it.

verses.rationale: Follow singular neighbor and expose needless delay.
verses.before: Do not say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again, and tomorrow I will give it,” when you have it with you.
verses.after: Do not tell your neighbor, “Go away and come back; I will give it tomorrow,” when you have it now.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again, and tomorrow I will give it,” when you have it with you.

verses.before: Do not plan harm against your neighbor who lives trustingly beside you.
verses.after: Do not plot harm against your neighbor who lives beside you in trust.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not plan harm against your neighbor who lives trustingly beside you.

verses.rationale: Keep cause qualification rather than universal ban on dispute.
verses.before: Do not contend with anyone without cause, when no harm has been done to you.
verses.after: Do not quarrel with someone for no reason when that person has done you no harm.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not contend with anyone without cause, when no harm has been done to you.

verses.before: Do not envy the violent and do not choose any of their ways,
verses.after: Do not envy a violent man or choose any of his ways.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not envy the violent and do not choose any of their ways,

verses.rationale: Keep moral contrast and intimacy of counsel.
verses.before: for the perverse are an abomination to the LORD, but the upright are in his confidence.
verses.after: For the devious are detestable to the LORD, but the upright share his confidence.
verses.tsw_comparator: for the perverse are an abomination to the LORD, but the upright are in his confidence.

verses.rationale: Retain explicit curse and household contrast.
verses.before: The curse of the LORD is on the house of the wicked, but he blesses the dwelling of the righteous.
verses.after: The LORD’s curse is on the house of the wicked, but he blesses the home of the righteous.
verses.tsw_comparator: The curse of the LORD is on the house of the wicked, but he blesses the dwelling of the righteous.

verses.rationale: Follow humble read form; keep reciprocal scoffing.
verses.before: Toward the scornful he is scornful, but to the humble he gives favor.
verses.after: He scoffs at scoffers, but gives grace to the humble.
verses.tsw_comparator: Toward the scornful he is scornful, but to the humble he gives favor.

verses.rationale: Resolve difficult lifting verb contextually without erasing shame.
verses.before: The wise will inherit honor, but fools display dishonor.
verses.after: The wise inherit honor, but fools carry away disgrace.
verses.tsw_comparator: The wise will inherit honor, but fools display dishonor.

verses.rationale: Retain plural sons and parental voice.
verses.before: Hear, children, the discipline of a father, and pay attention so that you may know understanding.
verses.after: Sons, listen to a father’s discipline; pay attention and learn understanding.
verses.tsw_comparator: Hear, children, the discipline of a father, and pay attention so that you may know understanding.

verses.rationale: Preserve teacher’s claim to good instruction.
verses.before: For I give you good teaching; do not abandon my instruction.
verses.after: For I give you good teaching; do not abandon my instruction.
verses.tsw_comparator: For I give you good teaching; do not abandon my instruction.

verses.rationale: Keep remembered unique relationship, not infer family genealogy.
verses.before: When I was a child with my father, tender and the only one before my mother,

verses.after: Then a woman came to meet him, dressed like a prostitute, her intentions concealed.

verses.before: She is loud and rebellious; her feet do not remain in her house.
verses.after: She is loud and defiant; her feet never stay at home.
verses.tsw_comparator: She is loud and rebellious; her feet do not remain in her house.

verses.before: Now in the street, now in the public squares, and at every corner she lies in wait.
verses.after: Now in the street, now in the squares, she lies in wait at every corner.
verses.tsw_comparator: Now in the street, now in the public squares, and at every corner she lies in wait.

verses.before: She seized him and kissed him; with a bold face she said to him:
verses.after: She seized him and kissed him; with a bold face she said,
verses.tsw_comparator: She seized him and kissed him; with a bold face she said to him:

verses.rationale: Preserve ritual context without asserting its sincerity.
verses.before: “I had sacrifices of well-being to offer; today I have fulfilled my vows.
verses.after: “I had fellowship offerings to make; today I fulfilled my vows.
verses.tsw_comparator: “I had sacrifices of well-being to offer; today I have fulfilled my vows.

verses.rationale: Keep flattering claim of personal pursuit.
verses.before: So I came out to meet you, diligently seeking your face, and I have found you.
verses.after: That is why I came out to meet you, to search eagerly for you—and I found you!
verses.tsw_comparator: So I came out to meet you, diligently seeking your face, and I have found you.

verses.before: I have spread coverings over my bed, colored linens from Egypt.
verses.after: I have spread coverings on my couch, patterned linen from Egypt.
verses.tsw_comparator: I have spread coverings over my bed, colored linens from Egypt.

verses.before: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
verses.after: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
verses.tsw_comparator: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

verses.rationale: Keep explicit sexual invitation and drinking image.
verses.before: Come, let us drink our fill of love until morning; let us delight ourselves with love.
verses.after: Come, let us drink our fill of love until morning; let us delight in lovemaking.
verses.tsw_comparator: Come, let us drink our fill of love until morning; let us delight ourselves with love.

verses.rationale: Preserve distancing the man rather than inserting husband in speech.
verses.before: For the man is not at home; he has gone on a distant journey.
verses.after: The man is not at home; he has gone on a long journey.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the man is not at home; he has gone on a distant journey.

verses.before: He took a bag of silver with him; he will return home at the full moon.”
verses.after: He took a bag of silver with him; he will not return home until the full moon.”
verses.tsw_comparator: He took a bag of silver with him; he will return home at the full moon.”

verses.rationale: Preserve agency and paired speech tactics.
verses.before: With much persuasion she turned him aside; with smooth lips she compelled him.
verses.after: With much persuasion she turned him; with smooth lips she drew him away.
verses.tsw_comparator: With much persuasion she turned him aside; with smooth lips she compelled him.

verses.rationale: Keep difficult fetters/fool wording rather than conjectured animal.
verses.before: Suddenly he followed her, like an ox going to slaughter, like a fool going to the restraint of discipline,
verses.after: All at once he follows her, like an ox going to slaughter, like a fool in fetters going to correction,
verses.tsw_comparator: Suddenly he followed her, like an ox going to slaughter, like a fool going to the restraint of discipline,

verses.rationale: Retain liver, bird, and life consequence.
verses.before: until an arrow pierces his liver, like a bird rushing into a snare, not knowing that it will cost his life.
verses.after: until an arrow pierces his liver; like a bird darting into a trap, he does not know that his life is at stake.
verses.tsw_comparator: until an arrow pierces his liver, like a bird rushing into a snare, not knowing that it will cost his life.

verses.before: And now, children, listen to me; pay attention to the words of my mouth.
verses.after: Now, sons, listen to me; pay attention to the words of my mouth.
verses.tsw_comparator: And now, children, listen to me; pay attention to the words of my mouth.

verses.rationale: Keep inner inclination and outer path.
verses.before: Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways; do not wander into her paths.
verses.after: Do not let your heart turn toward her ways; do not stray onto her paths.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways; do not wander into her paths.

verses.rationale: Retain many slain; strength/numerous ambiguity noted.
verses.before: For many are the wounded she has brought down, and numerous are all whom she has killed.
verses.after: For many are the wounded she has brought down; her slain are a mighty host.
verses.tsw_comparator: For many are the wounded she has brought down, and numerous are all whom she has killed.

verses.before: Her house is the way to Sheol, descending to the chambers of death.
verses.after: Her house is a road to Sheol, going down to the chambers of death.
verses.tsw_comparator: Her house is the way to Sheol, descending to the chambers of death.

verses.before: Does not Wisdom call? Does not Understanding raise her voice?
verses.after: Does not Wisdom call out? Does not Understanding raise her voice?
verses.tsw_comparator: Does not Wisdom call? Does not Understanding raise her voice?

verses.before: On the heights beside the way, at the crossroads, she takes her stand.
verses.after: On the heights beside the road, at the crossroads, she takes her stand.
verses.tsw_comparator: On the heights beside the way, at the crossroads, she takes her stand.

verses.before: Beside the gates, at the entrance to the city, at the entryways she cries aloud:
verses.after: Beside the city gates, at the entrance, at the open doorways, she cries:
verses.tsw_comparator: Beside the gates, at the entrance to the city, at the entryways she cries aloud:

verses.before: “To you, human beings, I call, and my voice is directed to all humanity.
verses.after: “To you, people, I call; my voice goes out to all humankind.
verses.tsw_comparator: “To you, human beings, I call, and my voice is directed to all humanity.

verses.before: O simple ones, learn prudence; O fools, gain an understanding heart.
verses.after: You inexperienced ones, learn good sense; you fools, learn understanding.
verses.tsw_comparator: O simple ones, learn prudence; O fools, gain an understanding heart.

verses.rationale: Retain quality and rightness of speech.
verses.before: Listen, for I will speak noble things, and the opening of my lips will bring what is right.
verses.after: Listen, for I speak worthy things; what comes from my lips is right.
verses.tsw_comparator: Listen, for I will speak noble things, and the opening of my lips will bring what is right.

verses.before: For my mouth speaks truth, and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
verses.after: My mouth speaks truth; wickedness is detestable to my lips.
verses.tsw_comparator: For my mouth speaks truth, and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

verses.before: All the words of my mouth are righteous; there is nothing twisted or crooked in them.
verses.after: All the words of my mouth are righteous; there is nothing twisted or crooked in them.
verses.tsw_comparator: All the words of my mouth are righteous; there is nothing twisted or crooked in them.

verses.before: They are all straightforward to the discerning and right to those who find knowledge.
verses.after: They are all straightforward to the discerning and right to those who find knowledge.
verses.tsw_comparator: They are all straightforward to the discerning and right to those who find knowledge.

verses.rationale: Keep preference rather than blanket rejection of wealth.
verses.before: Receive my discipline rather than silver, and knowledge rather than choice gold,
verses.after: Receive my discipline rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.
verses.tsw_comparator: Receive my discipline rather than silver, and knowledge rather than choice gold,

verses.before: for wisdom is better than jewels, and nothing you desire can compare with her.
verses.after: For wisdom is better than jewels; no desirable thing can compare with her.
verses.tsw_comparator: for wisdom is better than jewels, and nothing you desire can compare with her.

verses.before: I, Wisdom, dwell with prudence, and I find knowledge and discretion.
verses.after: I, Wisdom, dwell with good sense; I find knowledge and discretion.
verses.tsw_comparator: I, Wisdom, dwell with prudence, and I find knowledge and discretion.

verses.before: The fear of the LORD is hatred of evil. Pride and arrogance, the evil way, and a perverse mouth I hate.
verses.after: The fear of the LORD is hatred of evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and twisted speech.
verses.tsw_comparator: The fear of the LORD is hatred of evil. Pride and arrogance, the evil way, and a perverse mouth I hate.

verses.before: Counsel and sound wisdom are mine; I am understanding; strength is mine.
verses.after: Counsel and sound wisdom are mine; I am understanding; strength is mine.
verses.tsw_comparator: Counsel and sound wisdom are mine; I am understanding; strength is mine.

verses.before: By me kings reign, and rulers decree what is just.
verses.after: Through me kings reign and rulers decree what is just.
verses.tsw_comparator: By me kings reign, and rulers decree what is just.

verses.rationale: Follow pinned righteousness reading, not earth alternative.
verses.before: By me princes rule, and nobles— everyone who judge with righteousness.
verses.after: Through me princes govern, and nobles—all who judge rightly.
verses.tsw_comparator: By me princes rule, and nobles— all who judge with righteousness.

verses.before: I love people who love me, and people who diligently seek me will find me.
verses.after: I love those who love me, and those who seek me will find me.
verses.tsw_comparator: I love those who love me, and those who diligently seek me will find me.

verses.before: Riches and honor are with me, enduring wealth and righteousness.
verses.after: Wealth and honor are with me, enduring riches and righteousness.
verses.tsw_comparator: Riches and honor are with me, enduring wealth and righteousness.

verses.before: My fruit is better than gold, even fine gold, and my yield than choice silver.
verses.after: My fruit is better than gold, even fine gold; my yield surpasses choice silver.
verses.tsw_comparator: My fruit is better than gold, even fine gold, and my yield than choice silver.

verses.before: I walk in the path of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of justice,
verses.after: I walk on the path of righteousness, along the ways of justice,
verses.tsw_comparator: I walk in the path of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of justice,

verses.rationale: Preserve possessions rather than abstract reality alone.
verses.before: giving an inheritance to people who love me and filling their treasuries.
verses.after: giving substance as an inheritance to those who love me and filling their treasuries.
verses.tsw_comparator: giving an inheritance to those who love me and filling their treasuries.

verses.rationale: Retain qanah as acquired; note created/possessed possibilities.
verses.before: The LORD possessed me at the beginning of the LORD’s way, before the works of old.
verses.after: The LORD acquired me at the beginning of his way, before his works of long ago.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD possessed me at the beginning of the LORD’s way, before the works of old.

verses.rationale: Keep ancient establishment without later doctrinal additions.
verses.before: From ancient times I was established, from the beginning, before the earth.
verses.after: From ages past I was established, from the beginning, before the earth.
verses.tsw_comparator: From ancient times I was established, from the beginning, before the earth.

verses.rationale: Preserve birth imagery and primeval water.
verses.before: When there were no depths, I was brought forth, when there were no springs abounding with water.
verses.after: When there were no deeps, I was brought forth, when there were no springs heavy with water.
verses.tsw_comparator: When there were no depths, I was brought forth, when there were no springs abounding with water.

verses.before: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills, I was brought forth,
verses.after: Before the mountains were set in place, before the hills, I was brought forth,
verses.tsw_comparator: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills, I was brought forth,

verses.before: before the LORD had made the earth and the open fields, or the first dust of the world.
verses.after: before he made earth and open country or the first dust of the world.
verses.tsw_comparator: before the LORD had made the earth and the open fields, or the first dust of the world.

verses.before: When the LORD established the heavens, I was there; when the LORD inscribed a circle on the face of the deep;
verses.after: When he established the heavens, I was there; when he traced a circle on the face of the deep,
verses.tsw_comparator: When the LORD established the heavens, I was there; when the LORD inscribed a circle on the face of the deep;

verses.rationale: Retain source’s strong springs without adding fountains burst.
verses.before: when the LORD made firm the skies above, when the springs of the deep were established;
verses.after: when he made firm the clouds above, when the springs of the deep grew strong,
verses.tsw_comparator: when the LORD made firm the skies above, when the springs of the deep were established;

verses.before: when the LORD set a boundary for the sea so that the waters would not cross the command, when the LORD marked out the foundations of the earth—
verses.after: when he set the sea its boundary so the waters would not cross his command, when he marked out the earth’s foundations,
verses.tsw_comparator: when the LORD set a boundary for the sea so that the waters would not cross the command, when the LORD marked out the foundations of the earth—

verses.rationale: Choose craftsman sense of amon; flag child alternative.
verses.before: then I was beside the LORD, like a master worker; I was a delight day after day, rejoicing before the LORD always,
verses.after: I was beside him as a master worker. I was his delight day after day, playing before him at all times,
verses.tsw_comparator: then I was beside the LORD, like a master worker; I was a delight day after day, rejoicing before the LORD always,

verses.rationale: Preserve playful rejoicing and human delight.
verses.before: rejoicing in the LORD’s inhabited world and delighting in humanity.
verses.after: playing in his inhabited world, delighting in humankind.
verses.tsw_comparator: rejoicing in the LORD’s inhabited world and delighting in humanity.

verses.before: And now, children, listen to me: blessed are those who keep my ways.
verses.after: Now, sons, listen to me; happy are those who keep my ways.
verses.tsw_comparator: And now, children, listen to me: blessed are those who keep my ways.

verses.before: Hear discipline and become wise; do not neglect it.
verses.after: Listen to discipline and become wise; do not reject it.
verses.tsw_comparator: Hear discipline and become wise; do not neglect it.

verses.before: Blessed is the one who listens to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting beside my entrances.
verses.after: Happy is the person who listens to me, watching at my doors day after day, waiting at my doorposts.
verses.tsw_comparator: Blessed is the one who listens to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting beside my entrances.

verses.before: For whoever finds me finds life and obtains favor from the LORD.
verses.after: For whoever finds me finds life and obtains favor from the LORD.
verses.tsw_comparator: For whoever finds me finds life and obtains favor from the LORD.

verses.rationale: Keep missing/sinning ambiguity through misses; retain stark death contrast.
verses.before: But whoever sins against me harms their own life; everyone who hate me love death.”
verses.after: But whoever misses me harms his own life; all who hate me love death.”
verses.tsw_comparator: But whoever sins against me harms their own life; all who hate me love death.”

verses.before: Wisdom has built her house; she has hewn out her seven pillars.
verses.after: Wisdom has built her house; she has carved out its seven pillars.
verses.tsw_comparator: Wisdom has built her house; she has hewn out her seven pillars.

verses.before: She has slaughtered her animals; she has mixed her wine; she has also set her table.
verses.after: She has slaughtered her animals, mixed her wine, and set her table.
verses.tsw_comparator: She has slaughtered her animals; she has mixed her wine; she has also set her table.

verses.rationale: Retain female messengers and public appeal.
verses.before: She has sent out her young women; she calls from the highest places of the city:
verses.after: She has sent out her young women; she calls from the city’s highest places,
verses.tsw_comparator: She has sent out her young women; she calls from the highest places of the city:

verses.rationale: Match invitation later echoed by Folly.
verses.before: “Whoever is simple, turn in here!” To the one lacking sense she says,
verses.after: “Whoever is inexperienced, turn in here!” To one who lacks sense she says,
verses.tsw_comparator: “Whoever is simple, turn in here!” To the one lacking sense she says,

verses.before: “Come, eat of my bread and drink of the wine I have mixed.
verses.after: “Come, eat my bread and drink the wine I have mixed.
verses.tsw_comparator: “Come, eat of my bread and drink of the wine I have mixed.

verses.rationale: Choose inexperience as object while retaining path.
verses.before: Leave behind simplicity and live; walk in the way of understanding.”
verses.after: Leave inexperience behind and live; walk straight along the way of understanding.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Leave behind simplicity and live; walk in the way of understanding.”

verses.before: Whoever corrects a scoffer receives abuse, and whoever rebukes the wicked receives injury.
verses.after: Whoever disciplines a scoffer brings dishonor on himself; whoever corrects the wicked receives abuse.
verses.tsw_comparator: Whoever corrects a scoffer receives abuse, and whoever rebukes the wicked receives injury.

verses.before: Do not rebuke a scoffer, or the scoffer will hate you; rebuke the wise, and they will love you.
verses.after: Do not correct a scoffer, or he will hate you; correct a wise person, and he will love you.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not rebuke a scoffer, or the scoffer will hate you; rebuke the wise, and they will love you.

verses.before: Give instruction to the wise, and they will become still wiser; teach the righteous, and they will increase in learning.
verses.after: Give instruction to the wise, and they become wiser; teach the righteous, and they add to their learning.
verses.tsw_comparator: Give instruction to the wise, and they will become still wiser; teach the righteous, and they will increase in learning.

verses.rationale: Choose divine referent for plural holy ones; note ambiguity.
verses.before: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
verses.after: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
verses.tsw_comparator: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

verses.before: For through me your days will be multiplied, and years will be added to your life.
verses.after: For through me your days will multiply, and years will be added to your life.
verses.tsw_comparator: For through me your days will be multiplied, and years will be added to your life.

verses.rationale: Preserve personal consequences without denying effects on others.
verses.before: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself; and if you scoff, you alone will bear it.
verses.after: If you are wise, you are wise for your own benefit; if you scoff, you alone will bear it.
verses.tsw_comparator: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself; and if you scoff, you alone will bear it.

verses.before: Woman Folly is loud; she is simple and knows nothing.
verses.after: Folly is a noisy woman, all inexperience, knowing nothing.
verses.tsw_comparator: Woman Folly is loud; she is simple and knows nothing.

verses.before: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat at the highest places of the city,
verses.after: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the city’s high places,
verses.tsw_comparator: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat at the highest places of the city,

verses.before: calling to people who pass by, who are going straight on their ways:
verses.after: calling to those passing by who are going straight on their way,
verses.tsw_comparator: calling to those who pass by, who are going straight on their ways:

verses.before: “Whoever is simple, turn in here!” And to the one lacking sense she says,
verses.after: “Whoever is inexperienced, turn in here!” To one who lacks sense she says,
verses.tsw_comparator: “Whoever is simple, turn in here!” And to the one lacking sense she says,

verses.before: “Stolen water is sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.”
verses.after: “Stolen water is sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.”
verses.tsw_comparator: “Stolen water is sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.”

verses.rationale: Keep guest’s ignorance and underworld destination.
verses.before: But they do not know that the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
verses.after: But he does not know that the shades of the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
verses.tsw_comparator: But they do not know that the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.

verses.rationale: Keep collection title within verse and parental contrast.
verses.before: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise child makes a father glad, but a foolish child is the grief of a mother.
verses.after: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son brings his father joy; a foolish son brings his mother sorrow.
verses.tsw_comparator: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise child makes a father glad, but a foolish child is the grief of a mother.

verses.rationale: Retain wealth’s moral source and death.
verses.before: Treasures gained by wickedness do not profit, but righteousness delivers from death.
verses.after: Treasures gained by wickedness bring no benefit, but righteousness rescues from death.
verses.tsw_comparator: Treasures gained by wickedness do not profit, but righteousness delivers from death.

verses.rationale: Preserve proverbial assertion without added universal explanation.
verses.before: The LORD does not let the righteous go hungry, but the craving of the wicked the LORD pushes away.
verses.after: The LORD does not let the righteous go hungry, but he thwarts the craving of the wicked.
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD does not let the righteous go hungry, but the craving of the wicked the LORD pushes away.

verses.before: A slack hand makes poor, but the hand of the diligent makes rich.
verses.after: A slack hand brings poverty; a diligent hand brings wealth.
verses.tsw_comparator: A slack hand makes poor, but the hand of the diligent makes rich.

verses.before: Whoever gathers in summer is a prudent child, but whoever sleeps during harvest brings shame.
verses.after: A son who gathers in summer acts wisely; a son who sleeps at harvest brings shame.
verses.tsw_comparator: Whoever gathers in summer is a prudent child, but whoever sleeps during harvest brings shame.

verses.rationale: Select mouth as subject; note alternative violence covers mouth.
verses.before: Blessings are upon the head of the righteous, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
verses.after: Blessings rest on the head of the righteous, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
verses.tsw_comparator: Blessings are upon the head of the righteous, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.

verses.before: The memory of the righteous is a blessing, but the name of the wicked will rot.
verses.after: The memory of the righteous becomes a blessing; the name of the wicked rots away.
verses.tsw_comparator: The memory of the righteous is a blessing, but the name of the wicked will rot.

verses.before: The wise in heart receive commandments, but one with foolish lips will fall.
verses.after: The wise in heart accept commands, but a babbling fool comes to ruin.
verses.tsw_comparator: The wise in heart receive commandments, but one with foolish lips will fall.

verses.rationale: Preserve exposure rather than merely being known.
verses.before: Whoever walks in integrity walks securely, but whoever makes their ways crooked will be found out.
verses.after: Whoever walks with integrity walks securely; whoever twists his ways will be found out.
verses.tsw_comparator: Whoever walks in integrity walks securely, but whoever makes their ways crooked will be found out.

verses.rationale: Retain pinned repeated second line, not alternative witness.
verses.before: Whoever winks the eye causes trouble, and one with foolish lips will fall.
verses.after: A wink of the eye brings sorrow, and a babbling fool comes to ruin.
verses.tsw_comparator: Whoever winks the eye causes trouble, and one with foolish lips will fall.

verses.rationale: Repeat verse 6 second line and keep fountain.
verses.before: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
verses.after: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
verses.tsw_comparator: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.

verses.rationale: Keep covering image without inserting concealment policy.
verses.before: Hatred stirs up conflicts, but love covers all offenses.
verses.after: Hatred stirs up conflicts, but love covers every offense.
verses.tsw_comparator: Hatred stirs up conflicts, but love covers all offenses.

verses.before: Wisdom is found on the lips of the discerning, but a rod is for the back of one lacking sense.
verses.after: Wisdom is found on discerning lips, but a rod is for the back of one who lacks sense.
verses.tsw_comparator: Wisdom is found on the lips of the discerning, but a rod is for the back of one lacking sense.

verses.before: The wise store up knowledge, but the mouth of the fool brings ruin near.
verses.after: The wise store up knowledge, but a fool’s mouth brings ruin near.
verses.tsw_comparator: The wise store up knowledge, but the mouth of the fool brings ruin near.

verses.before: The wealth of the rich is their strong city; the ruin of the poor is their poverty.
verses.after: The wealth of the rich is their fortified city; the poverty of the poor is their ruin.
verses.tsw_comparator: The wealth of the rich is their strong city; the ruin of the poor is their poverty.

verses.before: The wages of the righteous lead to life; the income of the wicked leads to sin.
verses.after: The wages of the righteous lead to life; the income of the wicked leads to sin.
verses.tsw_comparator: The wages of the righteous lead to life; the income of the wicked leads to sin.

verses.rationale: Preserve causative misleading rather than only personal wandering.
verses.before: Whoever heeds discipline is on the path to life, but whoever rejects correction leads others astray.
verses.after: Whoever keeps discipline is a path to life, but whoever abandons correction leads others astray.
verses.tsw_comparator: Whoever heeds discipline is on the path to life, but whoever rejects correction leads others astray.

verses.rationale: Retain both deceptive concealment and active slander.
verses.before: Whoever conceals hatred has lying lips, and whoever spreads slander is a fool.
verses.after: Whoever conceals hatred has lying lips, and whoever spreads slander is a fool.
verses.tsw_comparator: Whoever conceals hatred has lying lips, and whoever spreads slander is a fool.

verses.before: When words are many, transgression is not absent, but whoever restrains their lips is prudent.
verses.after: Where words multiply, wrongdoing does not cease; whoever restrains his lips acts wisely.
verses.tsw_comparator: When words are many, transgression is not absent, but whoever restrains their lips is prudent.

verses.rationale: Retain value comparison and different body parts.
verses.before: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver; the heart of the wicked is of little worth.
verses.after: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver; the heart of the wicked is worth little.
verses.tsw_comparator: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver; the heart of the wicked is of little worth.

verses.before: The lips of the righteous feed many, but fools die for lack of sense.
verses.after: The lips of the righteous feed many, but fools die for lack of sense.
verses.tsw_comparator: The lips of the righteous feed many, but fools die for lack of sense.

verses.rationale: Choose divine subject; note toil adds nothing alternative.
verses.before: The blessing of the LORD makes rich, and the LORD adds no sorrow with it.
verses.after: The LORD’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no sorrow with it.
verses.tsw_comparator: The blessing of the LORD makes rich, and the LORD adds no sorrow with it.

verses.before: Doing wrong is like play to a fool, but wisdom is delight to one who has understanding.
verses.after: Doing wrong is sport to a fool; so is wisdom to a person of understanding.
verses.tsw_comparator: Doing wrong is like play to a fool, but wisdom is delight to one who has understanding.

verses.rationale: Keep different objects and unspecified giver.
verses.before: What the wicked dread will come upon them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
verses.after: What the wicked dread will come upon them; what the righteous desire will be granted.
verses.tsw_comparator: What the wicked dread will come upon them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.

verses.before: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked are no more, but the righteous have an everlasting foundation.
verses.after: The whirlwind passes, and the wicked are gone, but the righteous have an enduring foundation.
verses.tsw_comparator: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked are no more, but the righteous have an everlasting foundation.

verses.before: Like vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so is the lazy one to people who send them.
verses.after: Like vinegar to teeth and smoke to eyes, so is a sluggard to those who send him.
verses.tsw_comparator: Like vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so is the lazy one to those who send them.

verses.before: The fear of the LORD prolongs days, but the years of the wicked will be shortened.
verses.after: The fear of the LORD adds days, but the years of the wicked are cut short.
verses.tsw_comparator: The fear of the LORD prolongs days, but the years of the wicked will be shortened.

verses.before: The hope of the righteous is gladness, but the expectation of the wicked will perish.
verses.after: The hope of the righteous brings joy, but the expectation of the wicked perishes.
verses.tsw_comparator: The hope of the righteous is gladness, but the expectation of the wicked will perish.

verses.before: The way of the LORD is a stronghold to the person of integrity, but destruction to people who do evil.
verses.after: The LORD’s way is a stronghold for the upright, but ruin for those who do wrong.
verses.tsw_comparator: The way of the LORD is a stronghold to the person of integrity, but destruction to those who do evil.

verses.before: The righteous will never be shaken, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.
verses.after: The righteous will never be shaken, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.
verses.tsw_comparator: The righteous will never be shaken, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.

verses.rationale: Preserve fruit-bearing verb and violent severing.
verses.before: The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom, but a perverse tongue will be cut off.
verses.after: The mouth of the righteous bears wisdom, but the twisted tongue will be cut off.
verses.tsw_comparator: The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom, but a perverse tongue will be cut off.

verses.before: The lips of the righteous know what is pleasing, but the mouth of the wicked what is perverse.
verses.after: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable; the mouth of the wicked knows perversity.
verses.tsw_comparator: The lips of the righteous know what is pleasing, but the mouth of the wicked what is perverse.

verses.before: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD, but an accurate weight is the LORD’s delight.
verses.after: Dishonest scales are detestable to the LORD, but an accurate weight delights him.
verses.tsw_comparator: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD, but an accurate weight is the LORD’s delight.

verses.before: When pride comes, disgrace comes, but wisdom is with the humble.
verses.after: Pride arrives, and dishonor follows; wisdom is with the modest.
verses.tsw_comparator: When pride comes, disgrace comes, but wisdom is with the humble.

verses.before: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the crookedness of the treacherous destroys them.
verses.after: The integrity of the upright guides them; the crookedness of the faithless destroys them.
verses.tsw_comparator: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the crookedness of the treacherous destroys them.

verses.rationale: Retain wrath rather than specifying an event.
verses.before: Wealth does not profit on the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
verses.after: Wealth brings no benefit on the day of wrath, but righteousness rescues from death.
verses.tsw_comparator: Wealth does not profit on the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.

verses.before: The righteousness of the blameless makes their way straight, but the wicked fall by their own wickedness.
verses.after: The righteousness of the blameless makes their way straight; the wicked fall through their own wickedness.
verses.tsw_comparator: The righteousness of the blameless makes their way straight, but the wicked fall by their own wickedness.

verses.before: The righteousness of the upright delivers them, but the treacherous are caught by their own craving.
verses.after: The righteousness of the upright rescues them; the faithless are caught by their own craving.
verses.tsw_comparator: The righteousness of the upright delivers them, but the treacherous are caught by their own craving.

verses.rationale: Keep difficult strength term; avoid imported afterlife claim.
verses.before: When the wicked die, their hope perishes, and the expectation placed in strength comes to nothing.
verses.after: When a wicked person dies, hope perishes; expectation placed in strength dies too.
verses.tsw_comparator: When the wicked die, their hope perishes, and the expectation placed in strength comes to nothing.

verses.rationale: Retain reversal rather than generalized suffering.
verses.before: The righteous are rescued from trouble, and the wicked come into it instead.
verses.after: The righteous are freed from trouble, and the wicked take their place.
verses.tsw_comparator: The righteous are rescued from trouble, and the wicked come into it instead.

verses.rationale: Keep harmful speech and rescue through knowledge.
verses.before: With the mouth the godless destroy a neighbor, but through knowledge the righteous are rescued.
verses.after: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but through knowledge the righteous escape.
verses.tsw_comparator: With the mouth the godless destroy a neighbor, but through knowledge the righteous are rescued.

verses.before: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices; and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.
verses.after: When the righteous prosper, a city rejoices; when the wicked perish, there are shouts of joy.
verses.tsw_comparator: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices; and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.

verses.before: By the blessing of the upright a city is exalted, but by the mouth of the wicked it is torn down.
verses.after: Through the blessing of the upright a city is raised up; through the mouth of the wicked it is torn down.
verses.tsw_comparator: By the blessing of the upright a city is exalted, but by the mouth of the wicked it is torn down.

verses.before: Whoever despises a neighbor lacks sense, but a person of understanding keeps silent.
verses.after: Whoever despises his neighbor lacks sense; a person of understanding keeps silent.
verses.tsw_comparator: Whoever despises a neighbor lacks sense, but a person of understanding keeps silent.

verses.before: A gossip goes about revealing secrets, but one faithful in spirit conceals a matter.
verses.after: A gossip goes about revealing confidences, but a trustworthy person keeps a matter covered.
verses.tsw_comparator: A gossip goes about revealing secrets, but one faithful in spirit conceals a matter.

verses.before: Where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety.
verses.after: Without guidance a people falls; with many counselors there is deliverance.
verses.tsw_comparator: Where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety.

verses.before: Whoever becomes surety for a stranger will surely suffer, but whoever hates striking hands in pledge is secure.
verses.after: Whoever guarantees a stranger’s debt will suffer for it; whoever avoids pledging is secure.
verses.tsw_comparator: Whoever becomes surety for a stranger will surely suffer, but whoever hates striking hands in pledge is secure.

verses.rationale: Retain troubling contrast without substituting diligent men.
verses.before: A gracious woman gains honor, and ruthless people gain wealth.
verses.after: A gracious woman holds on to honor, and ruthless men hold on to wealth.
verses.tsw_comparator: A gracious woman gains honor, and ruthless people gain wealth.

verses.rationale: Keep kindness’s benefit and bodily self-harm.
verses.before: A person of steadfast love does good to their own life, but the cruel trouble their own flesh.
verses.after: A man of faithful love does good to himself; a cruel man harms his own flesh.
verses.tsw_comparator: A person of steadfast love does good to their own life, but the cruel trouble their own flesh.

verses.rationale: Preserve wages/sowing contrast and reliable reward.
verses.before: The wicked earn deceptive wages, but whoever sows righteousness receives a sure reward.
verses.after: The wicked earn deceptive wages, but one who sows righteousness earns a lasting reward.
verses.tsw_comparator: The wicked earn deceptive wages, but whoever sows righteousness receives a sure reward.

verses.before: Whoever stands firm in righteousness moves toward life, but whoever pursues evil moves toward death.
verses.after: True righteousness leads to life; whoever pursues evil pursues his own death.
verses.tsw_comparator: Whoever stands firm in righteousness moves toward life, but whoever pursues evil moves toward death.

verses.before: Those crooked in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but those whose way is blameless are the LORD’s delight.
verses.after: Twisted hearts are detestable to the LORD; those whose way is blameless delight him.
verses.tsw_comparator: Those crooked in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but those whose way is blameless are the LORD’s delight.

verses.rationale: Render hand-to-hand assurance idiom; keep descendants.
verses.before: Be assured: the wicked will not go unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will escape.
verses.after: Be assured: evil will not go unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will escape.
verses.tsw_comparator: Be assured: the wicked will not go unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will escape.

verses.before: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout is a beautiful woman who turns away from good judgment.
verses.after: A gold ring in a pig’s snout— such is a beautiful woman who turns from good judgment.
verses.tsw_comparator: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout is a beautiful woman who turns away from good judgment.

verses.before: The desire of the righteous ends only in good, but the expectation of the wicked in wrath.
verses.after: The desire of the righteous ends only in good; the hope of the wicked ends in wrath.
verses.tsw_comparator: The desire of the righteous ends only in good, but the expectation of the wicked in wrath.

verses.before: One gives freely and yet increases all the more; another withholds what is right and comes only to poverty.
verses.after: One person gives freely and gains still more; another withholds what is due and comes only to need.
verses.tsw_comparator: One gives freely and yet increases all the more; another withholds what is right and comes only to poverty.

verses.before: A generous person will flourish, and whoever gives water will themselves be watered.
verses.after: A generous person will flourish; one who refreshes others will also be refreshed.
verses.tsw_comparator: A generous person will flourish, and whoever gives water will themselves be watered.

verses.rationale: Retain sale rather than changing to donation.
verses.before: The people curse the one who holds back grain, but blessing is upon the head of the one who sells it.
verses.after: People curse the one who withholds grain, but blessing rests on the head of the one who sells it.
verses.tsw_comparator: The people curse the one who holds back grain, but blessing is upon the head of the one who sells it.

verses.before: Whoever diligently seeks good seeks favor, but whoever searches for evil— it will come to them.
verses.after: Whoever earnestly seeks good seeks favor; whoever searches for evil will find it coming upon him.
verses.tsw_comparator: Whoever diligently seeks good seeks favor, but whoever searches for evil— it will come to them.

verses.before: Whoever trusts in wealth will fall, but the righteous will flourish like a green leaf.
verses.after: Whoever trusts in wealth will fall, but the righteous will flourish like a leaf.
verses.tsw_comparator: Whoever trusts in wealth will fall, but the righteous will flourish like a green leaf.

verses.before: Whoever troubles their own household will inherit wind, and a fool will become servant to the wise in heart.
verses.after: Whoever brings trouble on his household will inherit wind, and a fool will serve the wise in heart.
verses.tsw_comparator: Whoever troubles their own household will inherit wind, and a fool will become servant to the wise in heart.

verses.rationale: Retain difficult taking lives expression without evangelistic insertion.
verses.before: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and whoever gains lives is wise.
verses.after: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and one who wins lives is wise.
verses.tsw_comparator: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and whoever gains lives is wise.

verses.rationale: Keep repayment unspecified, not automatically reward.
verses.before: If the righteous receive their due on earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!
verses.after: If the righteous are repaid on earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!
verses.tsw_comparator: If the righteous receive their due on earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!

verses.before: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but whoever hates correction is senseless.
verses.after: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge; whoever hates correction is brutish.
verses.tsw_comparator: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but whoever hates correction is senseless.

verses.before: A good person obtains favor from the LORD, but one who devises evil the LORD condemns.
verses.after: A good person obtains favor from the LORD, but he condemns a schemer.
verses.tsw_comparator: A good person obtains favor from the LORD, but one who devises evil the LORD condemns.

verses.before: No one is established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous will not be moved.
verses.after: No one is established through wickedness, but the root of the righteous will not be shaken.
verses.tsw_comparator: No one is established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous will not be moved.

verses.rationale: Retain wife’s strength and bodily decay contrast.
verses.before: A capable spouse is a crown to their partner, but one who brings shame is like decay in the bones.
verses.after: A capable wife is her husband’s crown; one who brings shame is rot in his bones.
verses.tsw_comparator: A capable spouse is a crown to their partner, but one who brings shame is like decay in the bones.

verses.before: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the guidance of the wicked is deceitful.
verses.after: The plans of the righteous are just; the schemes of the wicked are deceitful.
verses.tsw_comparator: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the guidance of the wicked is deceitful.

verses.rationale: Retain ambushing words and open them referent.
verses.before: The words of the wicked lie in wait for blood, but the mouth of the upright delivers them.
verses.after: The words of the wicked lie in wait for blood, but the mouth of the upright rescues them.
verses.tsw_comparator: The words of the wicked lie in wait for blood, but the mouth of the upright delivers them.

verses.before: The wicked are overthrown and are no more, but the house of the righteous will stand.
verses.after: The wicked are overthrown and are no more, but the house of the righteous stands.
verses.tsw_comparator: The wicked are overthrown and are no more, but the house of the righteous will stand.

verses.before: A person is praised according to their insight, but one with a twisted heart is despised.
verses.after: A man is praised according to his good judgment, but one with a twisted heart is despised.
verses.tsw_comparator: A person is praised according to their insight, but one with a twisted heart is despised.

verses.rationale: Retain servant reading and pretension contrast.
verses.before: Better to be lightly regarded and have a servant than to honor oneself and lack bread.
verses.after: Better to be lightly esteemed and have a servant than to put on importance and lack bread.
verses.tsw_comparator: Better to be lightly regarded and have a servant than to honor oneself and lack bread.

verses.rationale: Preserve animal care and paradoxical cruelty.
verses.before: The righteous know the life of their animals, but the compassion of the wicked is cruel.
verses.after: The righteous know the needs of their animals, but even the compassion of the wicked is cruel.
verses.tsw_comparator: The righteous know the life of their animals, but the compassion of the wicked is cruel.

verses.before: Whoever works their land will have plenty of bread, but whoever pursues empty things lacks sense.
verses.after: Whoever works his land has enough bread; whoever chases empty pursuits lacks sense.
verses.tsw_comparator: Whoever works their land will have plenty of bread, but whoever pursues empty things lacks sense.

verses.rationale: Choose catch for ambiguous net/stronghold; note uncertainty.
verses.before: The wicked desire the catch of evil people, but the root of the righteous produces fruit.
verses.after: The wicked covet the catch of evildoers, but the root of the righteous yields fruit.
verses.tsw_comparator: The wicked desire the catch of evil people, but the root of the righteous produces fruit.

verses.before: An evil person is trapped by the transgression of their lips, but the righteous escape trouble.
verses.after: An evil person is snared by sinful speech, but the righteous come out of trouble.
verses.tsw_comparator: An evil person is trapped by the transgression of their lips, but the righteous escape trouble.

verses.rationale: Follow causative repayment read form without naming agent.
verses.before: From the fruit of the mouth a person is filled with good, and the work of a person’s hands returns to them.
verses.after: From the fruit of his mouth a person is filled with good, and the work of his hands is repaid to him.
verses.tsw_comparator: From the fruit of the mouth a person is filled with good, and the work of a person’s hands returns to them.

verses.before: The way of a fool is right in their own eyes, but the wise listen to counsel.
verses.after: A fool’s way is right in his own eyes, but the wise listen to counsel.
verses.tsw_comparator: The way of a fool is right in their own eyes, but the wise listen to counsel.

verses.rationale: Keep prompt anger versus concealment of dishonor.
verses.before: A fool’s anger is known at once, but the prudent overlook an insult.
verses.after: A fool’s anger is known at once; a prudent person overlooks an insult.
verses.tsw_comparator: A fool’s anger is known at once, but the prudent overlook an insult.

verses.before: Whoever speaks truth declares what is right, but a false witness speaks deceit.
